plan.caveat: Empirical bound for the pinned one-card target-only 18 GB cache, 4K BF16 allocation and <=128 generated-token receipts. Resident lookup bytes are a design substitution, not measured. Keep whole-host ownership, all native census/quality gates and live stops.
